negative_reviews.author: Matt Barn
negative_reviews.text: The spicy vegan ramen was pretty good but nothing special. The vegetarian gyoza, miso soup and pumpkin croquettes were meh. The service was slow

negative_reviews.author: King Ling
negative_reviews.text: Ambience is good and was nice. Not sure why the reviews are all 5 stars. My Tom yum soup had two prawns and two pieces of shrimp, one egg and soup was watery. The maki roll was alright as well. We also waited to the end of our main meal for tap water to arrive. Wouldn't rush back sadly. Had high hopes.

negative_reviews.author: C P
negative_reviews.text: Genuinely the most disappointing meal I've had. I came for my 50th birthday based on an Instagram video and it couldn't have been more different. We were sat in an area that looked like it was the holding area for people who had ordered takeaway, the bar was covered in dirty glasses, my blue bubble margarita don't come with a bubble, the food was under seasoned and underwhelming, and the edamame had bits of other food in there. To top it off, the toilets were like a horror film...so stinking and dirty! They took the cost of some things off the bill but honestly we would never come back ☹️

negative_reviews.author: Bridge Phillips
negative_reviews.text: Firstly, the food looked nothing like the menu. Genuinely the WORST ramen i’ve had in my entire life. I’ve had instant ramen that tasted better and would’ve been much cheaper. I ordered the steak ramen, it has thick juicy steak slices on the menu but came with 4 flimsy pieces that looked like it had been boiled. The half egg was over cooked. SO incredibly overpriced for the quality you’re getting. £15 for that??? in this economy? I would’ve taken a photo but it didn’t deserve to be on my camera roll. I’ve never left a bad review but this takes the cake. Safe to say, I won’t be coming back.
